device.model: HD S60 (the universal "UNI" build; the main code calls itself HD_S60-1-0-4-1 and accepts /c/S60.abs and /c/UNIWERSAL87436723.abs)
device.type: DVB-S2 HD satellite receiver with USB recording
device.soc: ALi M3601S (the main-code chunk's version; the main code is the SDK's "M3602 HD STB" / "S3602 HD STB" platform build, its all-code image M3601SAllCode.abs)
device.family: M3602 (chips/m3602.py), matched by the main-code chunk's version

image.version: 1.0.4.1 PVR (main-code chunk 103000003002002 "M3601S"; bootloader Libcore 1.1.6@Auto_20100413 built 2011-07-01 by Davy.Wu; Libcore 5.2.0@SDK4.0ba.5.2_20110615, Application 1.0.0@SDK4.0ba.5.3_GLS_S2_20110701, HDMI_ALI_E_110516_1)
image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 (DVBS2---0.1.0), maincode 0x014000 (chunk "103000003002002" M3601S, LZMA 0x1466E6 bytes -> 4.5 MB), Radioback 0x15C000 (1.0.0), Menuback 0x163000 (1.0.0), BootLogo 0x168000 (1.0.0), defaultdb 0x16F000 (1.1.0), userdb 0x19FF80 (1.0.0, 0x60070 bytes) -- the whole 2 MB flash; no HDCPKey and no seecode chunk

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the official download)
source.note: The manufacturer's USB update Software_UNI_S60_1.0.4.1_PVR_2012-08-28.rar (the .abs alone); fetched 2026-10-11 from the mirror's Opticum / INNE folder.

simulator.note: As the M3602 family (chip ID 0x3602, 2026-10-11): the bootloader prints "MC: APP  init ok" and the application its banner (Libcore 5.2.0, Application 1.0.0@SDK4.0ba.5.3_GLS_S2_20110701) after about 110 s of wall clock, dumps its clock registers and then resets its tuner over and over ("Reset tuner N time!!!"): the M3601S's internal S3501 demodulator and its tuner are not modelled; no GE command in a 2.5-minute run (5 GE commands by 120 M instructions).  The chip ID 0x3603 is no better: the bootloader then stays in its RAM copy and prints nothing in 120 M instructions, as the Cabletech URZ0086's does.

desc: The official 1.0.4.1 PVR update (2012-08-28) of the Opticum HD S60 satellite receiver, the "UNI" (universal) build: the first ALi M3601S image in the collection -- a single-CPU member of the S3602 platform (no seecode chunk, no HDCPKey) with the S3501 internal DVB-S2 demodulator, on a 2 MB flash with the Opticum N2's chunk set (Radioback, Menuback, BootLogo, defaultdb, userdb).

Its bootloader is the Libcore 1.1.6 build of 2011-07-01 ("DVBS2---0.1.0"); the application is the SDK 4.0 satellite line of mid-2011 (SDK4.0ba.5.3_GLS_S2), a year before the Thomson THT501's terrestrial one.
The application's own update accepts /c/S60.abs, /c/UNIWERSAL87436723.abs and the key files /c/KEY1_5684.txt, /c/KEY2_ETERNAL_567436.txt, /c/KEY2_ONEUSE_567436.txt from a USB stick.
